verdict.rationale: Circle documents two narrow bulk capabilities: Gateway batch-processing endpoints for EIP-3009 authorizations, and a user-controlled wallets call that creates one or more wallets in one request. Neither amounts to general-purpose bulk operations across many items. missing for 10: general batch APIs for transfers and payouts across many wallets, bulk operations in the CLI or MCP tooling, documented batch size limits and partial-failure semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Endpoints for batch processing of EIP-3009 authorizations
Creates a challenge for user initialization and creates one or more wallets.
